name: vLLM 0.12 on 4x Arc Pro B60 (TP=4): Qwen3-VL-30B chat 1K->1K TTFT (concurrency 16)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Embedded LLM, Feb 14 2026). Sparkle 4x Intel Arc Pro B60 workstation, TP=4, 24GB/456GB-s per GPU. Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct. vLLM 0.12 vs Intel LLM-Scaler 1.2. Concurrency 16/32/64, 1K->1K and 1K->2K scenarios. Chat scenario 1K->1K at concurrency 16. TTFT = request->first-token.
notes: vLLM 0.12 standard build, lower TTFT than LLM-Scaler (4.2s) for chat. Per-request TTFT at c=16.
